source: .claude/skills/telugu-jyotisha/reference.md §9 (standard Vimshottari years) and the skill's rule: first dasha lord = Moon's nakshatra lord; balance = unelapsed fraction × lord years; antardashas proportional, same order.
notes: Order repeats every 9 nakshatras starting at Ashwini (Ketu). yearDays = length of a dasha year in days; 365.25 (Julian year) is common in software, some almanacs use 365.2425 or a 360-day savana year — confirm against published charts with the chart fixtures.
